requirements: The valid fixture passes semantic validation and applies without mutating the base pack or base archetypes.
Names, ancestry rules, new tables, table extensions, custom archetype, operation module, mechanical package, and level guidance merge transactionally.
Every invalid mutation produces its expected diagnostic and leaves the base runtime unchanged.
The custom archetype generates valid deterministic Quick, Standard, and Deep profiles using the custom ancestry.
Standard and Deep operation fields obey depth eligibility.
Custom mechanical output respects level guidance and package references.
Generated profiles record both the base and custom pack in generator receipts and provenance.
Installed packs survive storage round trips, dependency removal is blocked, and corrupted storage recovers with diagnostics.
